title: Would be good when traveling maybe?
text:
Would be good when traveling maybe?. I got this for use in my office but ended up returning after a month because it stopped heating.

Pros: liked the size and how it folded down
Cons: steam burned my fingers when pouring (like steam came out of the hing area and bite your finger holding the handle), because it was built to fold down, which I did like, but it had a downside that it would collapse in on itself when trying to plug or unplug it spilling water that was sometimes boiling hot, and the biggest con was it stopped heating so I returned it.

This would be pretty good to use when traveling or only on a hear and there basis. For more regular use I'd go with another kind.
